# Struct `puc::msg::NullMessage`

Message carrying no typed data and no payload bytes.

**[Protocol Contract](puc_protocol_contracts.md#symbol-puc_protocol_contracts_1_puc_protocol_contracts000004):**

**Kind:** Message  
**Type:** [puc::msg::NullMessage](#)  
**Purpose:** Represents an explicit typed no-data payload and gives generic dispatch a valid schema at message ID zero.  
**Producers:** Components that need a typed no-data envelope.  
**Consumers:** Generic dispatch and components expecting an explicit no-data payload.
